verdict.rationale: Deel is an HR and payroll SaaS that handles sensitive workforce data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack has no documented setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The MCP, sandbox, OAuth and webhook docs cover other capabilities and do not address training-data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
